description: This file defines the InfoLogStrategy class which implements logging behavior for informational messages within the ngMayo.Logging.LogStrategy namespace. It extends AbstractLogStrategy and overrides Execute methods to send info-level logs using an injected ILogger instance.

classes.name: InfoLogStrategy
classes.description: A class that implements an informational logging strategy, inheriting from AbstractLogStrategy and providing specific implementations for executing log messages.

methods.name: InfoLogStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logging strategy with an ILogger instance.

methods.name: Execute (LogModel log)
methods.description: Logs the message contained within the LogModel object at info level.

methods.name: Execute (string message, string data)
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with supplied message and data parameters at info level.
